Darius Build Guide : [25.24] Challenger Darius Top Guide :: **### DO NOT START MOST FIGHTS WITH YOUR PULL!**

 This applies at all stages of the game, but it's most important during the early game. A lot of your matchups can be beaten because you can use your pull to turn the tides in the middle of a fight. If you start with your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Apprehend](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497) in a matchup like [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Sett](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/sett-153), you cannot kite out of his E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/facebreaker-964)  range and you could possibly die just from that. Your E is **EXTREMELY IMPORTANT IN THE EARLY GAME** so understanding that you need to hold off from using it into certain champions can mean the difference between hard winning a lane, or getting absolutely obliterated.

  
Depending on what your enemy top laner is the enemy jungler will just straight up ignore you, as there are a lot of lanes where you can just 2v1 them if he tries to gank you. That being said, there are a lot of top+jungle combos that can explode you within their combo rotation and make it impossible for you to outplay it, so don't get cocky.

If you are playing into a ranged matchup, you are going to suffer, big time. [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) struggles most against ranged opponents and you need to play around your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) timing as well as using brushes to at least stay in experience range. One way you can make sure you are safe in brushes is by starting [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Oracle Lens](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/oracle-lens-313), making it impossible for them use their [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Stealth Ward](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/stealth-ward-100) in a brush for vision as you can kill it that way. You can't ward up either, but you don't care about that in a ranged matchup.

You can also look to get priority for Voidgrubs [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/minions/voidgrub)  and get them early with your jungler. Another thing you can do is heal up on jungle camps when you are low. [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/decimate-495)  heals him when he hits the outer edge on large jungle monsters, so if Gromp [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/minions/gromp) , Krugs [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/minions/ancient-krug)  or Voidgrubs [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/minions/voidgrub)  are up, you can walk to one of those camps, ideally the closest one to you, and get some extra healing.

This is going to be your strongest point in the entire game. Your biggest spike in terms of power will be between levels 11 and 13\. At level 11 you get your rank 2 ultimate [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/noxian-guillotine-498)  and the damage spikes up heavily, and at level 13 you get your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Apprehend](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497) fully maxed, meaning your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) armor penetration](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/general/armor-penetration) is at the maximum value. Your dueling power is **massive** at this point, and depending on how the lane went, you can force out 2 or 3 people to have to permanently deal with you on side lane, or go to teamfight and run through the enemy comp. If you get that one reset you can probably go off and kill everyone. That being said, there are still a few things to keep in mind when playing the mid game:

**[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) is horrible in teamfights without his summoner spells up**. If you want to go into a teamfight, unless the enemy comp has 3 melee champions with no mobility, and little cc, you're probably going to get kited into oblivion. If you are fighting just [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Hwei](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/hwei-182) and you have no [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14) and no [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2), you're basically just a much tankier minion that eats damage for your team, as you're probably not gonna get to anyone, like ever. [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) has to play around his summoner spell cooldowns [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-shard/ability-haste-3) , to the point that even if you see someone overextending on side lane you might not want to burn a single summoner spell for them unless they have a massive bounty, as it can mean it won't be up for a big fight later on, like a Dragon [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/minions/dragon)  fight or a Baron [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/minions/baron-nashor)  contest.

  
If your summoner spells are down it's actually better to go on side lane and pressure them up, forcing the enemies to come to you and diverting attention until they are up.

Another thing to remember is that **[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) does not want to be the main engager**. Obviously you can start fights with your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14)+E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497)  combo, but most of the time you'd rather not. You are actually a great **follow up champion**, letting your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Rammus](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/rammus-24), [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Zac](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/zac-112), [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Nautilus](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/nautilus-93), etc. start the fight first, lock down someone, and THEN you want to go in. Being the first one to go in means you risk losing a ton of health before you even get to your second or third passive stack [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/hemorrhage-494) , and that can be very bad. You can also wait out a bit out of vision, waiting for the opponents to burn a crucial lockdown/escape tool and then looking for a pick angle, if you really need to be the first one to engage.

Keep in mind that you don't need to kill the first person you attack, if you can just get 5 stacks [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/hemorrhage-494)  off of that person and then jump onto the squishies you're good to go, like getting 5 stacks [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/hemorrhage-494)  on an [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Alistar](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/alistar-4) who is in the frontline tanking, and then ignoring him after to go into the backline.

It's not as horrible as you'd think, but it's not amazing either. With [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) teamfights usually go one of 2 ways: you either instantly get burst down, or you wipe them out with a single reset. Your rank 3 ultimate [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/noxian-guillotine-498)  is extremely high, but the issue is that at this point in the game there's a lot of things that can deny you the reset, such as getting hyper cc locked down or last second shielding/healing.

Going on side lane can actually be very risky as you can get collapsed on and die. At this point there's also a lot of champions who you would bully in lane but that can actually just match you on side lane. One of the best examples here would have to be [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Sion](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/sion-6). You can beat him out in lane really hard, but if you get to 5/6 items, unless you have [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Blade of the Ruined King](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/blade-of-the-ruined-king-145) it will take you up to a literal minute of constantly hitting him to actually get him down. He won't be able to win the 1v1, but you're gonna sit there and hit him for a solid 25 seconds and he would barely lose half his health, which is just not worth it for you, and if you don't constantly go in front of him he can just ult [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/unstoppable-onslaught-688)  away, wasting that entire time for you. Having no [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Teleport](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/teleport-6) also hurts a lot here, as if the enemy does they can match you on side lane then appear at a teamfight long before you.

This is the time when [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) **has** to have his summoner spells up to fight, it's no longer ever an option. You absolutely need them to get access to the high priority targets and squishy champions quickly, or else you will find it really hard to do anything meaningful in fights.  
[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Death's Dance](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/deaths-dance-308) is also quite important during this time to have in a lot of situations, same goes for Sterak's [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/steraks-gage-288) . Because burst is so insanely high and the game can be ended by a single teamfight it is important to be able to ensure you have the highest chance of getting your reset before you explode, and those two are very good at delaying your death. [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Kaenic Rookern](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/kaenic-rookern-533) is also extremely valuable at this point if the enemy has a ton of magic damage as the shield becomes massive.

You mostly try to do what you do in the mid game, looking for someone else to engage for you and then following up. It's also at this point where if you are fighting champions that can hyper teamfight and outvalue you, like [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Kennen](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/kennen-49) or [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ornn](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/ornn-139) it could be best to sit on side lane and force them to match you, the only issue is that usually they run [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Teleport](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/teleport-6) and can just clear waves until they are needed and can almost instantly join up a fight.

In my opinion, you absolutely **need** your summoner spells up in the mid to late game as [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98). Any fight past 16/17 minutes you will most likely need at least one out of your 2 summoner spells, that being either [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14), or [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2), and if you end up taking [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ignite](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ignite-11) then you **must** get kills in lane or get a massive advantage, or because your teamfights will always suffer. I will break down each of these summoner spells and their purpose so you can get a better understand of exactly **why** they are so important:

[ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14) Flash: [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) has absolutely **zero mobility**. He gets kited extremely easily, which is why most builds have some sort of extra speed items for him, such as [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Dead Man's Plate](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/dead-mans-plate-287) or [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Force of Nature](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/force-of-nature-80), and even [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Boots of Swiftness](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/boots-of-swiftness-38) for the extra speed [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-shard/movement-speed-7)  and slow resist. The only reliable way he could get close to other champs if he had insane speed, from something like [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Zilean](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/zilean-17) speedup [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/time-warp-85)  or a way to close the gap quickly with a dash or blink, and here is where [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14) comes in.  
This is the way for him to ensure that he can get on top of someone fast and that he can actually deal damage and be able to become a threat in teamfights. The champ doesn't have the highest range ability wise, so he literally has to walk towards you. Almost every other bruiser has some type of speedup or way to close the gap quickly. [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Garen](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/garen-51) has his Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/decisive-strike-255)  to cleanse slows and speed up, [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Olaf](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/olaf-53) becomes fully immune to cc in his ult [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/ragnarok-268) , [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Sett](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/sett-153) has his ult [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/the-show-stopper-965) , even [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Trundle](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/trundle-65) has his Frozen Domain [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/frozen-domain-613) , and so on. You are almost always forced to have your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14) up to reliably close the gap. This is why I think taking [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Cosmic Insight](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/cosmic-insight-58) is so good, as it will allow you to have it up sooner so you can possibly look for more plays.

[ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) Ghost: Much like [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14) this summoner spell will allow you to get to your targets quicker, but it's also a very good summoner spell for lane kill pressure. The reason [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) is actually really hard to deal with if he freezes on his side of the map, is because he can pop his [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) and kill you before you get to your turret. There are a lot of matchups where [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) is used to chase down people on lane, or to kite out certain abilities. For example, you can use your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) to get out of [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Garen](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/garen-51)'s spin [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/judgment-257) , avoiding a lot of damage and making sure he cannot get you into lethal range. Another example would be to force [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Riven](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/riven-83) to use more of her dashes, either from her Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/broken-wings-420)  or her E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/valor-422)  if she wants to chase you down hard, after which you can use the extra speed to turn on her.

[ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ignite-11) Ignite: If you take this then you have to get a very good lead, because if not you will go into the mid and late game being much weaker without [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2). Your passive [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/hemorrhage-494)  combined with it will actually bleed out people insanely hard, but you need to take fights and force plays, because if not missing the speed of [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) makes it so that you are forced to always have [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14) up for teamfights, as opposed to having either [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) or [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14).

**## HEMORRHAGE (P)**

  
![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png)

You don't always need to have your passive in fights to win them, but it gives you a massive advantage if you get it. The AD means **almost** no champion should be able to 1v1\. There are a few exceptions, like how [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Illaoi](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/illaoi-128) can still beat you in melee range really hard if she hits you with her E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/test-of-spirit-742)  and then uses her ultimate [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/leap-of-faith-743) , but overall if you aren't too low when you finally get your passive you shouldn't lose out the 1v1\. There's nothing really flashy to mention here about his passive, what you see is what you get.

**## DECIMATE (Q)**

  
![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png)

This is your main ability when it comes to trading in lane. It gives you very good damage and it is your primary source of waveclear. It is **very** important you hit the outer edge of the ability, the issue is there are a ton of champions who have multiple dashes and can make it to where it's basically never possible to hit your Q. Champions like [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Riven](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/riven-83), [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Vayne](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/vayne-76), [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Wukong](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/wukong-80), etc. make it only possible to hit your Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/decimate-495)  if you use your E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497)  first, and that's not even supposed to be the case, it's actually a bug.

The best way to make sure you hit your ability on these type of champions is to wait until they burn the dashes and then use it. Sometimes it's easier said than done, like with [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Riven](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/riven-83), so you can use your Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/decimate-495)  to burn one dash before fighting. For example, if [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Jax](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/jax-15) can jump [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/leap-strike-74)  in to your melee range to dodge your Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/decimate-495) , but he is low enough to where you kill him with the rest of your combo, it doesn't really matter. You use your Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/decimate-495)  to force out his escape tool. If he doesn't jump on you and jumps away to a minion, that's still fine as you burn his escape tool, so you can have a window where you can straight up dive him.

Another way to hit your Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/decimate-495)  vs them it to use Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/decimate-495) +[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14) to reposition yourself and ensure the hit, but the enemy can also predict this and use their [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14). This is a mindgame for both sides. If your Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/decimate-495) +[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14) would kill your opponent but you know their [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14) is up, make it seem like you are going to 100% commit and use your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14), **but just hold it**. It also gives you a stronger level 6.

[ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/biscuit-delivery-53) Biscuit Delivery: This rune is used in some very specific matchups for early game sustain. If you pop it while you are low you can actually get up to 100 or more extra [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) health regen](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/general/health-regeneration) in a very short amount of time, possibly swinging a fight in your favor.

[ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/cosmic-insight-58) Cosmic Insight: Very good rune for [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98), I love to take it in both the unique setup and the standard one. Having your summoner spells come off cooldown sooner is extremely important for [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98), so much so I have made a specific section detailing **why** they are so important.

I have made this section specifically to outline the differences between Conqueror and Phase Rush on Darius playstyle wise. In my opinion there are enough changes in your overall gameplan and play pattern that it needs a specific chapter guide for it. With that said, let's begin.

**TL;DR for the entire thing:**  
\-[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Conqueror](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/conqueror-69) is usually better early to mid game and in 1v1s  
\-[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Phase Rush](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/phase-rush-9) gives you much better teamfighting in the mid to late game  
\-[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Conqueror](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/conqueror-69) gives you more damage and extra healing, but at 30 minutes you get the same ad and once you are past 40 you straight up get more always ([![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Gathering Storm](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/gathering-storm-42)), but still no healing  
\-[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Conqueror](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/conqueror-69) allows you to take extended trades in lane much better than [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Phase Rush](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/phase-rush-9) does  
\-[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Phase Rush](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/phase-rush-9) allows [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) to be able to short trade very well by speeding away after his rotation  
\-[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Phase Rush](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/phase-rush-9) allows you to play out some very tough matchups, especially ranged ones  
\-[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Phase Rush](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/phase-rush-9) can act as a mini [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) in some specific cases

### **Explanation:**

Almost every single Darius runs this [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Conqueror](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/conqueror-69). It's very easy to stack for Darius, it's like stacking your passive 6 times instead of 5, but Q inner edge hits also stack it. On top of that, the precision page is very good for Darius. You have [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Triumph](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/triumph-17), which is a very good rune for him, he can turn around fights at low health with it, then there's [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Legend: Alacrity](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/legend-alacrity-19), solid choice to just take for more auto attacks, and then there's [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Last Stand](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/last-stand-24), which works very well with Darius as he usually fights at lower health. So it's not just the keystone rune but also the precision tree itself. That being said, the [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Sorcery](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/sorcery-63) tree is also great for Darius.  
[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Nimbus Cloak](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/nimbus-cloak-70) is always good, as well as the option of [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Manaflow Band](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/manaflow-band-35) in some specific lanes for more spell rotations. [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Celerity](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/celerity-38) is always good, and [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Gathering Storm](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/gathering-storm-42) is very underrated.

At level 18 [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Conqueror](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/conqueror-69) will give you 28.8 damage when fully stacked.  Gathering storm will always give you exactly 28.8 damage as well starting from 30 minutes. So if you get to 30 minutes you always have the Conqueror damage, still no healing, but you match the damage, and anything past 30 minutes is straight up more damage. On top of that, the 20 minute amount, which is 15 damage, is still decent and almost fully makes up for not having the [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Conqueror](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/conqueror-69) damage.

There are also matchups where you cannot fully proc [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Conqueror](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/conqueror-69), like a ton of ranged matchups, or where the mobility of Phase Rush vastly outvalues the damage and healing of [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Conqueror](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/conqueror-69). In matchups such as [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Vayne](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/vayne-76), [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Quinn](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/quinn-111), [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Heimerdinger](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/heimerdinger-40), etc. you cannot really proc up [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Conqueror](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/conqueror-69), you don't have the time for it. You actually want to do short trades into most ranged matchups, but the issue is that you usually **need** to start with your E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497)  in those matchups, as they will never let you get close enough to just slow them with W [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/crippling-strike-496) .

With Conqueror if you do your E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497) +auto+W [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/crippling-strike-496) +Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/decimate-495)  combo and then try to run away, there is a very good chance they will just auto attack you a ton as you run away, and you will end up losing the trade, or straight up kill you.  
[![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Vayne](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/vayne-76) can just hard chase you down and space you really hard, [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Quinn](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/quinn-111) can do the same, [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Kennen](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/kennen-49) can just stun you up in melee range after your combo and do his rotation, even some matchups like can use dashes to chase you down and do their side of the combo. But if you have [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Phase Rush](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/phase-rush-9), you can do your side and then speed away.  
It won't mean you won't take any damage back, but someone like [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Kennen](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/kennen-49) would have to chase you down really hard to get his E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/lightning-rush-247)  mark on you and then stun you up, or [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Riven](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/riven-83) would have to use more of her Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/broken-wings-420)  dashes just to get into your melee range, or [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Vayne](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/vayne-76) would need to commit to an even longer chase just to be able to poke you down, and so on. So now you can start the short trades with E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497)  and not get punished as hard.

Another very good thing about [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Phase Rush](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/phase-rush-9) is that it's kinda like a mini [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2).  
You can proc it up with an auto+W [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/crippling-strike-496) +Q [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/decimate-495)  and then keep chasing the person down, which can allow you do save your E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497)  for when your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Phase Rush](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/phase-rush-9) goes out. For example into [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Nasus](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/nasus-37) if he uses his slow [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/wither-184)  you almost always need to pull him back because he will outrun you, but with [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Phase Rush](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/phase-rush-9) you can tank through most of the slow and keep up with him, possibly getting in an extra auto attack or 2, and then using your E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497) .

EXPLAINING MY UNIQUE SETUP

Currently I am doing a rather strange build for [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98), and it usually looks something like this:

![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png)

What I am going to do in this section is try to explain **why** I am trying this setup and what I like about it.

**## The reduction of summoner spell cooldowns**

  
As I specified in the mid and late game chapter guides, [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) cannot play teamfights during that time if his summoner spells aren't up, so I came up with this combo:  

## [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/cosmic-insight-58) Cosmic Insight + [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/ionian-boots-of-lucidity-113) Ionian Boots of Lucidity

  
Your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14) and [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) will both be up 1 minute sooner than usual, which doesn't seem that massive, but there are a lot of times when having summoner spells be up just 30 seconds sooner can make a difference, and this is absolutely massive for your **all in timers in the early game**. If you are playing vs [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Vayne](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/vayne-76) for example, and she takes [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Flash](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/flash-14) and [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2), she can just always trade the summoner spell you use to run away and kite. For example, you [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) to chase her down and she does the same. You **need** your summoner spell to get close to her **but she doesn't, and can just chase you down without it**. If you have this combo it would mean there would be a full minute where she wouldn't actually have it up, and you can abuse that window to get a kill. It might not seem that massive, but there are matchups where this window is literally your only window to **ever get a lead**.

Another example, this one being in the mid game:  
You see an opponent overextending on the side lane, no real bounty, but you can still get 300 gold for killing them. Dragon is up in 3 minutes. If you use [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) now it would mean it won't be up for Dragon and it could be really bad for you, but with the less cooldown you would have it up in time. Obviously this is a pretty specific case, but my point is you can find more kill angles and outplay moments because you would have your summoner spells up sooner.  
In a 25 minute game you would probably use your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Ghost](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/summoner-spell/ghost-2) around 5 times, and even that can be a little much. If you had the combo you could use it 7 times in almost the same time as the 5, just 1 extra minute. Again, doesn't seem like that much, but those 2 extra times can mean you get an early kill where the opponent wasn't expecting you to have summoner spells back up, or allowing you to punish someone greedy in the mid to late game when you normally wouldn't be able to.

**## Extra mana during laning phase**

  
One issue [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) has is that in the early game it's actually pretty easy to go out of mana if you use your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Apprehend](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497) more than 3 times. You can only do it a select few times, and if the champion you are playing against is someone like [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Jax](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/jax-15) or [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Riven](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/riven-83), who can just jump onto you a lot, you know that you can't always use your pull **because you would run out of [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) mana](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/general/mana)**. Having [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Manaflow Band](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/manaflow-band-35) instead of [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Celerity](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/celerity-38) can help out to fix up this issue well. It makes it to where you can even "poke" opponents more. Into quite a few matchups you could actually just use E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497)  to deal your full combo and you would be fine, for example [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Illaoi](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/illaoi-128), the issue is that if you do it too much and it doesn't result in a kill or forcing them to recall you will run out of [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) mana](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/general/mana) and then they can beat you. However, due to the extra [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) mana](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/general/mana) of that rune you don't really need to worry about it.

**## Diversity in both small runes and items**

  
You don't actually need to do this exact setup every time, and a lot of times you can change up small runes depending on the matchup, same for items. For example, you can take [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Triple Tonic](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/triple-tonic-77) instead of [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Cash Back](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/cash-back-80) if you want the extra AD at your level 6 and the extra kill point at 9, making you use a little less [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) mana](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/general/mana) as your E [ ![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) ](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/apprehend-497)  loses a bit of its cost when you put a point in it. [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Nimbus Cloak](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/nimbus-cloak-70) can be changed to [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Manaflow Band](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/manaflow-band-35) to have some insane [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) mana](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/wiki/general/mana) sustain for lane, or changing [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Celerity](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/celerity-38) for [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Transcendence](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/transcendence-37). You might not need the speed [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Dead Man's Plate](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/dead-mans-plate-287) provides due to your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Phase Rush](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/reforged-rune/phase-rush-9), so you can take [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Death's Dance](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/deaths-dance-308) instead, which is an insane item for teamfighting as it gives an extra reward for getting your reset, and it's a pretty massive reward. On the same note, you can take [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Kaenic Rookern](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/kaenic-rookern-533) instead of [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Force of Nature](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/force-of-nature-80), and if you combine it with your [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Sterak's Gage](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/item/steraks-gage-288), you will be an **absolute MONSTER** and it will take them a lot to take you down.

**## I PERSONALLY FIND IT REALLY FUN**

  
This one isn't factual, but I just wanted to place it here either way. This is a setup that I've found that I have a lot of fun with. I have been enjoying the general playstyle of it, and there will be people who play [![](https://www.mobafire.com/images/spacer.png) Darius](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/champion/darius-98) and they might not enjoy it personally, but I really like it a lot, again **PERSONALLY!**

+Massive lane bully in a ton of melee matchups, **most** tanks will despise you  
+Incredibly high carry power, a single reset in a teamfight can ace the entire enemy team  
+Can build differently for a lot of matchups, typically buying a specific component item can win you out the lane big time and Darius doesn't really mind delaying his spike item  
+Need to be shut down early on or he can run over the game very fast  
+Soaks up a ton of pressure in the side lane  
+Can 2v1, 3v1 and even 4v1 enemies when ahead, after the first kill the others follow shortly after  
+His high armor pen ensures his late game damage doesn't fall off super hard vs tanks who just stack a lot of armor

\-Low mobility, he can get kited extremely easily  
\-If the enemy team comp has mostly ranged champs you're basically a cannon minion  
\-Extremely summoner spell reliant, the later the game goes the more he needs his summs  
\-Can have decent mana issues early on and that can be abused  
\-Has some absolutely disgusting matchups to play into  
\-Overall low ability ranges, he actually need to be decently close to you to get his pull off

The Darius build I trust wins lane early and closes games fast. Darius is a juggernaut with simple tools that hit hard: stack Hemorrhage, yank with Apprehend, and finish with Noxian Guillotine. Manage spacing, track cooldowns, and your trades snowball fast.

I’ve mained him for years and climbed using this exact setup. In this guide, I’ll give you the items, runes, and skill order I use, plus matchup notes, lane plans, and mid-game rules for turning one kill into the whole side of the map. Keep it tight, play your windows, and make every stack count.


Understanding the Darius Build Fundamentals

Darius thrives on extended trades and his ability to dunk low‑health targets with Noxian Guillotine. A strong Darius build amplifies his natural tankiness and damage so that he can push advantages early and carry team fights. 

I always start by thinking about my lane match‑up and the overall enemy team composition. If I see heavy attack damage on the other side, I lean into armor and health; if the enemy has multiple mages or crowd control, I pivot toward magic resist and movement speed.

A good foundation for any Darius build begins with Doran’s Blade and a Health Potion. Doran’s Blade offers early attack damage and lifesteal, letting you sustain through trades. Against ranged poke, Doran’s Shield can be the smarter choice because its health regen reduces harass. 

At level one, unlock Decimate (Q) and position the blade’s outer circle to hit enemy champions while healing yourself. This single ability determines your lane dominance, so practicing its timing and spacing is essential.

When building core items, I prioritize a mythic that offers both damage and mobility.
